titulo: NASA Student Aviation Challenge Focuses on Nation’s Infrastructure
cuerpo: NASA’s next Gateways to Blue Skies competition invites collegiate teams to imagine innovative new ways aircraft could inspect land-based infrastructure, such as bridges and tunnels, to improve safety, reliability, and costs by 2035 or sooner.
